extDescription.message: Set a session length: only videos that fit in the remaining time are shown, then YouTube gently closes.

startTitle.message: Before you go in, set your intention.

startLead.message: YouTube stays closed until a session is running. Pick a length and write down what you're here to do.

startCustomRange.message: Enter a whole number between $1 and $2 minutes.

startIntentionPlaceholder.message: E.g. watch the derailleur adjustment tutorial, then close.

confirmPrompt.message: Breathe. Is this really what you want to do right now?

confirmReady.message: The timer starts as soon as you click.

endEarly1.message: Stopping before the end takes strength.

endEarly2.message: You chose to stop. Good call.

endNext1.message: Get up, stretch, take a deep breath.

endNext2.message: A glass of water, and on to the next thing.

endNext3.message: The rest of your day is waiting.

endNext4.message: Close the tab while it's easy.

tooLongTitle.message: This video doesn't fit in your session.

tooLongDetail.message: It has $1 left, you have $2 left.

popupIdle.message: No session running. YouTube stays closed until you start one from the YouTube page.

optFitTitle.message: Only those that fit in the session

optFitDesc.message: The list isn't refilled: it gets shorter as the session goes on.

optHideDesc.message: Nothing beside, below or at the end of the video.
